H8202.def: from «08199»; judge; Shaphat, the name of four Israelites:--Shaphat.

H8203.def: or Shphatyahuw {shef-at-yaw'-hoo}; from «08199» and «03050»; Jah has judged; Shephatjah, the name of ten Israelites:-- Shephatiah.

H8205.def: from «08192»; bareness; concretely, a bare hill or plain:--high place, stick out.

H8206.et: pl. of an unused noun from the same as (08207) and meaning the same
H8206.def: plural of an unused noun from the same as «08207» and meaning the same; serpents; Shuppim, an Israelite:--Shuppim.

H8207.et: from an unused root meaning the same as (07779)
H8207.def: from an unused root meaning the same as «07779»; a kind of serpent (as snapping), probably the cerastes or horned adder:--adder.

H8208.def: from «08231»; beautiful; Shaphir, a place in Palestine:--Saphir.

H8209.et: intensive of a form corresponding to (08208)
H8209.def: (Aramaic) intensive of a form corresponding to «08208»; beautiful:--fair.

H8210.def: a primitive root; to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out:--cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

H8211.def: from «08210»; an emptying place, e.g. an ash-heap:--are poured out.

H8212.def: feminine of a derivative from «08210»; a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis:--privy member.

H8213.def: a primitive root; to depress or sink (expec. figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive):--abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low(-er).

H8214.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08213»:--abase, humble, put down, subdue.

H8217.def: from «08213»; depressed, literally or figuratively:--base(-st), humble, low(-er, -ly).

H8219.def: from «08213»; Lowland, i.e. (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine:--low country, (low) plain, vale(-ley).

H8221.def: probably from «08192»; bare spot; Shepham, a place in or near Palestine:--Shepham.

H8222.def: from «08193»; the beard (as a lip-piece):--beard, (upper) lip.

H8223.def: formed like «08221»; baldly; Shapham, an Israelite:--Shapham.

H8224.def: feminine plural of «08221»; Siphmoth, a place in Palestine:--Siphmoth.

H8225.def: patrial from «08221»; a Shiphmite or inhabitant of Shepham:--Shiphmite.

H8226.def: a primitive root; to conceal (as a valuable):--treasure.

H8227.def: from «08226»; a species of rock-rabbit (from its hiding), i.e. probably the hyrax:--coney.

H8228.et: from an unused root meaning to abound
H8228.def: from an unused root meaning to abound; resources:--abundance.

H8231.def: a primitive root; to glisten, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) fair:--X goodly.

H8232.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «08231»; to be beautiful:--be acceptable, please, + think good.

H8234.def: the same as «08233»; Shepher, a place in the Desert:--Shapper.

H8236.def: the same as «08235»; Shiphrah, an Israelitess:--Shiphrah.

H8237.def: from «08231»; splendid, i.e. a tapestry or canopy:--royal pavilion.

H8238.def: (Aramaic) from «08231»; the dawn (as brilliant with aurora):--X very early in the morning.

H8239.def: a primitive root; to locate, i.e. (generally) hang on or (figuratively) establish, reduce:--bring, ordain, set on.

H8240.def: from «08239»; a (double) stall (for cattle); also a (two-pronged) hook (for flaying animals on):--hook, pot.

H8241.def: from «07857» (for alliteration with «07110»); an outburst (of anger):--little.

H8242.def: from «08264»; properly, a mesh (as allowing a liquid to run through), i.e. coarse loose cloth or sacking (used in mourning and for bagging); hence, a bag (for grain, etc.):--sack(-cloth, -clothes).

H8245.def: a primitive root; to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill):--hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).

H8246.def: a denominative from «08247»; to be (intensively, make) almond-shaped:--make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.

H8247.def: from «08245»; the almond (tree or nut; as being the earliest in bloom):--almond (tree).

H8248.def: a primitive root; to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to:--cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See «07937», «08354».

H8250.def: from «08248»; a beverage; moisture, i.e. (figuratively) refreshment:--drink, marrow.

H8251.def: or shiqquts {shik-koots'}; from «08262»; disgusting, i.e. filthy; especially idolatrous or (concretely) an idol:-- abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).

H8252.def: a primitive root; to repose (usually figurative):--appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet(-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

H8254.def: a primitive root; to suspend or poise (especially in trade):--pay, receive(-r), spend, × throughly, weigh.

H8255.def: from «08254»; probably a weight; used as a commercial standard:--shekel.

H8256.def: or (feminine) shiqmah {shik-maw'}; of uncertain derivation; a sycamore (usually the tree):--sycamore (fruit, tree).

H8257.def: (abbreviated Am. 8:8); a primitive root; to subside; by implication, to be overflowed, cease; causatively, to abate, subdue:--make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.

H8259.def: a primitive root; properly, to lean out (of a window), i.e. (by implication) peep or gaze (passively, be a spectacle):-- appear, look (down, forth, out).

H8260.def: from «08259»; a loophole (for looking out), to admit light and air:--window.

H8261.def: passive participle of «08259»; an embrasure or opening (compare «08260») with bevelled jam:--light, window.

H8262.def: a primitive root; to be filthy, i.e. (intensively) to loathe, pollute:--abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, × utterly.

H8263.def: from «08262»; filth, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) an idolatrous object:--abominable(-tion).

H8264.def: a primitive root; to course (like a beast of prey); by implication, to seek greedily:--have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).

H8265.def: a primitive root; to ogle, i.e. blink coquettishly:--wanton.

H8266.def: a primitive root; to cheat, i.e. be untrue (usually in words):--fail, deal falsely, lie.

H8267.def: from «08266»; an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial):--without a cause, deceit(-ful), false(-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, + lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.

H8269.def: from «08323»; a head person (of any rank or class):--captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord, ((-task- ))master, prince(-ipal), ruler, steward.

H8270.def: from «08324»; a string (as twisted (compare «08306»)), i.e. (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively, as the centre of strength):--navel.

H8271.et: a root corresponding to that of (08293)
H8271.def: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to that of «08293»; to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside:--begin, dissolve, dwell, loose.

H8272.def: of foreign derivation; Sharetser, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite:--Sharezer.

H8273.et: from an unused root meaning to glare
H8273.def: from an unused root meaning to glare; quivering glow (of the air), expec. the mirage:--heat, parched ground.

H8274.def: from «08273» and «03050»; Jah has brought heat; Sherebjah, the name of two Israelites:--Sherebiah.

H8276.def: a primitive root; to intwine:--wrap together, wreath.

H8277.def: a primitive root; properly, to puncture (compare «08279»), i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive:--remain.

H8278.def: from «08277»; stitching (as pierced with a needle):--service.

H8279.def: from «08277»; a (carpenter's) scribing-awl (for pricking or scratching measurements):--line.

H8280.def: a primitive root; to prevail:--have power (as a prince).

H8282.def: feminine of «08269»; a mistress, i.e. female noble:--lady, princess, queen.

H8283.def: the same as «08282»; Sarah, Abraham's wife:--Sarah.

H8284.def: probably feminine of «07791»; a fortification (literally or figuratively):--sing (by mistake for «07891»), wall.

H8285.et: from (08324) in its original sense of pressing
H8285.def: from «08324» in its original sense of pressing; a wrist-band (as compact or clasping):--bracelet.

H8286.def: from «08276»; tendril; Serug, a postdiluvian patriarch:--Serug.

H8287.et: probably from (08281) (in the sense of dwelling [compare (08271)] and (02580)
H8287.def: probably from «08281» (in the sense of dwelling (compare «08271») and «02580»; abode of pleasure; Sharuchen, a place in Palestine:--Sharuhen.

H8288.def: from «08308»; a thong (as laced or tied):--((shoe-)) latchet.

H8289.def: probably abridged from «03474»; plain, Sharon, the name of a place in Palestine:--Lasharon, Sharon.

H8290.def: patrial from «08289»; a Sharonite or inhabitant of Sharon:--Sharonite.

H8291.et: pass part from the same as (08321)
H8291.def: passive participle from the same as «08321»; a grapevine:--principal plant. See «08320», «08321».

H8292.def: or (by permutation) shriyqah {sher-ee- kaw'}; feminine passive participle of «08319»; a whistling (in scorn); by analogy, a piping:--bleating, hissing.

H8294.def: by permutation for «05629»; superfluity; Serach, an Israelitess:--Sarah, Serah.

H8295.def: a primitive root; to gash:--cut in pieces, make (cuttings) pieces.

H8297.def: from «08269»; dominative; Sarai, the wife of Abraham:--Sarai.

H8298.def: probably from «08324»; hostile; Sharay, an Israelite:--Sharai.
